title: BPW-2026-0577
text:
[CONSENT ITEM(S)]
BPW-2026-0577
CD 13
AFE – STATE WATER RESOURCES CONTROL BOARD
Bureau of Sanitation and Office of Accounting are requesting Board approval and execution of an Authority for Expenditure in the amount of $229,063 for encumbrance of Sewer Construction Maintenance funds to pay for the annual National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System and Storm Water fees for the period covering July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027.
(AE27760513M, Fund 760 - Sewer Operations & Maintenance Fund, Dept. 50, Appropriation Unit 50EX82)
